key_facts: Poundland and its 11,000 employees hope a last-minute rescue deal can delay the retailer's collapse; the discount chain has been moving toward administration after its owners blocked access to cash in its bank accounts.

A deadline to find a buyer expires at midnight; sources told the BBC more time is expected to be given following the release of £10m in funding, while about £50m had reportedly been frozen by Gordon Brothers, which bought the chain for £1 last year.

A 10-day moratorium protecting Poundland from creditors expires on Thursday and could be extended if a solvent deal is possible; Gordon Brothers denies accusations of forcing a piecemeal sale of the 600 stores and stock, and says the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading".

Poundland boss Barry Williams said like-for-like sales were up 11.4% and the business made a £18.1m profit in the year to September, versus losses of £68m the previous year; interest in stores has come from Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M.
importance_reason: Значимое событие для розничного сектора Великобритании с потенциальной потерей рабочих мест, но без системного эффекта на финансовые рынки.

key_facts: The number of toys sold in the UK up to October was 17% higher than the same period last year, and growth is at a 10-year high, according to research company Circana.
The kidult market (toys and games for those aged over 12) grew, with a 22% increase in the value of sales in the first half of the year.
Connected toys account for less than 1% of market sales; nearly half of toy sales come in the build-up to Christmas, and sales growth was significant for toys priced between £5 and £10.
importance_reason: Sector-level retail data with notable growth figures, but limited direct market impact and no sharp surprise for broad markets.

key_facts: Traversing the Strait of Hormuz remains one of the most dangerous trips a vessel can take; despite US Navy assistance, ships are still being attacked. Transit requires crew agreement, war risk insurance, and a final captain's decision.
Sea mines resting on the seabed or drifting can be a low-cost threat that stops tanker traffic. The US says it has cleared the Omani route, with shipments running at about 75% of pre-conflict levels.

Autonomous uncrewed mine-hunting systems (e.g., Thales Uncrewed Surface Vehicle with sonar and AI-assisted seabed imaging, and the US XLUUV from Anduril) are increasingly used to reduce risk to crews; in early September Iranian forces recovered an uncrewed US underwater vehicle that the Pentagon described as a malfunctioning older device with no classified equipment.
importance_reason: Feature-style analysis of mine-clearing technology in an active Gulf conflict zone with shipping impact, but no new market-moving event or hard market data.
market_link: Continued mine and attack risk in the Strait of Hormuz keeps tanker transit costly and constrains Gulf oil and LNG flows; the ~75% shipment level cited is a potential supply-side factor for oil prices.
